results.description:
She's grumpy. He's hot. And now they're next-door disasters in the making.

When Ayan pulls Tisha from the ocean, he expects gratitude—not a glare and a snarky comeback. She's gorgeous, sure, but her grumpiness makes him want to run the other way... until fate keeps throwing them together, and her scowl starts to look a little like a challenge.

Tisha knows Ayan is trouble. He's charming, confident, and everything she shouldn't want. One night should be enough to get him out of her system. But when she fakes it in bed, it flips a switch in him—and suddenly, Mr. Cool and Collected is obsessed with getting under her skin... and into her heart.

He's determined to uncover what she's hiding. She's convinced she can keep her walls up. But when sparks fly, secrets surface, and hearts are on the line, will they push each other away—or fall harder than either of them saw coming?

Dive into this sizzling grumpy-sunshine, girl-next-door romantic comedy with snark, spice, and a whole lot of heart.
